comment: D1 metric registry — every user-visible number rendered on 2+ surfaces. The checker replays EXACTLY the queries each page sends (source field pins the code); comparison is surface-vs-surface (self-maintaining), never against hand-baked constants. consistency=must-equal => numbers must match bit-for-bit; documented-difference => a note explaining window/unit divergence is mandatory and the values are still reported.

metrics.label: Per-person utilization %
metrics.note: People insights use the windowless /people/dashboard/utilization endpoint (server default window); the Reports utilization page sends startDate=month-start&endDate=+3months (ReportsTabContent filters from getDefaultReportDateRange). Values may legitimately diverge; the census reports the max per-person delta. Product debt if large: neither surface labels its window to the user.

surfaces.source: People.tsx:69 / api-client.ts:377 getUtilization() — bare array, no params
ReportsTabContent.tsx:306 getUtilization(filters); filters = getDefaultReportDateRange() camel keys

metrics.label: Over-allocated people count
metrics.note: Derived per surface from the same two utilization endpoints as person.utilization_pct — same window caveat applies.

metrics.label: Active/total projects count
metrics.note: Dashboard counts projects active within its single-day window (today→today); the Projects page shows all projects regardless of date. A project ending yesterday or starting tomorrow appears in the page count but not the dashboard. First census: dashboard 44 vs page 48 (4 gap). If the dashboard card is labeled 'Active Projects' this is honest; verify at review.

metrics.label: Per-person active project count
metrics.note: The utilization endpoint's project_count counts only projects with assignments active TODAY (migration 070: start_date <= today AND end_date >= today, baseline scenario only); the raw assignment list carries all rows regardless of temporal status. 沈设计 first census: 4 active vs 7 total. Both numbers are correct for their surfaces — insights wants 'what now', management wants 'everything'. Product risk: if either UI labels this as just 'projects' without temporal context, the user sees two different numbers for the same person.

surfaces.source: People utilization endpoint project_count per person
GET /api/assignments full list — distinct projects per person (matches utilization endpoint's project_count semantics)
